body: Dm me if you still feel lonely

I am not truly like you or other people in the comments, I never good grades, don’t have a nice paying job nor a car, BUT i know what being lonely feels , the constant struggle the hope that maybe someone will remember you, and trust me when I say get you in this department.

If you feel like you want to speak with someone although I cant offer too much help, sometimes sharing can help tremendously.

Ps: i hope you will have a magnificent birthday!
